name: Aromatics complexes (paraxylene, benzene)
principle: A naphtha reformer makes aromatics, which are extracted and fractionated; paraxylene is recovered by adsorption (Parex), the other xylenes are isomerised (Isomar) and toluene is converted to xylenes and benzene (Tatoray). Hengyi's Brunei complex adds an LD Parex unit recovering 2.3 Mtpa of paraxylene, taking total paraxylene capacity above 3.8 Mtpa.

suppliers.name: Honeywell UOP
suppliers.product: CCR Platforming, Parex, Isomar, Tatoray, Sulfolane

performance.metric: LD Parex paraxylene recovery at Hengyi Brunei
performance.basis: total paraxylene capacity above 3.8 Mtpa after Phase 2

source.note: Oil & Gas Journal, Hengyi lets contract for aromatics expansion at Brunei complex, 25 February 2021

performance.metric: para-xylene yield on crude oil for crude-to-aromatics plants
performance.unit: % by weight of crude (typical complexes 5-10%; new crude-to-PX plants expected >20%)
performance.basis: Nexant, Disruption in Aromatics (17 Jan 2019): "PX yields on crude oil by weight are typically from five to ten percent, but these new plants are expected to yield over 20 percent by converting heavy crude"; PX-per-tonne-naphtha and complex energy-use figures were not stated in open pages read
